mapper.select: select count(*) from fun_physics_answer_record where user_id = #{userId} and is_correct = 1
select count(*) from fun_physics_answer_record where user_id = #{userId} and is_correct = 1 and date(challenge_date) = curdate()
select count(distinct date(challenge_date)) as consecutive_days from fun_physics_answer_record where user_id = #{userId} and date(challenge_date) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)
select type, count(*) as total_count, sum(case when is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as correct_count from fun_physics_answer_record where user_id = #{userId} group by type
